description: This file defines a Java interface named JsonFieldSelector, which models a set of JSON pointers used to select multiple fields in a JSON object. It provides methods for creating new instances, retrieving pointers and size, checking if empty, and converting to string.

classes.name: JsonFieldSelector
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of JSON pointers for selecting multiple fields from a JSON object, with methods for creation, querying, and string representation.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new JsonFieldSelector from given JSON pointer strings.

methods.name: getPointers
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of JSON pointers included in this field selector.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of JSON pointers in this selector.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether this field selector contains any JSON pointers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of this field selector, either the original selector string or a default string.
